Let me confirm the final slide number and the revenue slide for completeness.

Good — that confirms slide 12 as the last. Let me verify the slide numbers I haven't actually seen yet (1, 2, 5, 6, 10, 11).

All twelve slides confirmed 1–12. Two details left: slide 9's title and the banner text.

Transition caught mid-fade. Let me view slides 6 and 7 properly at full frame.
